map.→ 打开临界角 θc工具: -> Open the critical angle θc tool
map.临界角存在条件？: Under what condition does the critical angle exist?
map.全反射有折射光吗？: Is there a refracted ray under total internal reflection?
map.判断是否发生全内反射。: Determine whether total internal reflection occurs.
map.填写「光密介质折射率 n₁」。: Enter "refractive index n1 of the optically denser medium".
map.填写「光疏介质折射率 n₂」。: Enter "refractive index n2 of the optically less dense medium".
map.没有折射光，能量全反射回原介质，但存在倏逝波（用于干涉/传感）。: There is no refracted ray; the energy is totally reflected back into the original medium, but evanescent waves do exist (they are used in interference and sensing).
map.由两介质折射率算全反射临界角。: Compute the critical angle for total internal reflection from the refractive indices of two media.
map.由光密到光疏介质的折射率，按 θc = arcsin(n₂/n₁) 计算全反射临: Given the refractive indices from the denser to the less dense medium, compute the critical angle for total internal reflection as θc = arcsin(n2/n1).
map.须光从光密(n大)射向光疏(n小)且入射角≥θc，反方向无全反射。: The light must travel from the denser medium (larger n) to the less dense one (smaller n) with an incidence angle >= θc; the reverse direction has no total internal reflection.
